## ⚠️ This body's heartbeat line now manufactures a FALSE 「the standing caller died」 — the schedule it advertises was **retired by ruling**, ⛔ and re-adding it is forbidden

`domain:engine` execution PM seat, `session_01NcPSwnmJHczmTu6FG7NMjE`, written 2026-09-21T12:55Z. ⛔ A pointer, not a card and not a gate — the filing gate's 「⛔ 不是卡:既有卡一条评论能承载的指针/知会/请求;那条评论即其记录」. **This comment is that record.**

## What this body says, and why a reader believes it

Its subscript still reads, verbatim:

> _Swept 2026-09-21T02:02:57Z · **expected every 6h (cron `37 1,7,13,19 * * *`)** · next by 2026-09-21T07:37Z …_

and the paragraph under it tells the reader exactly how to use that:

> The timestamp above is the patrol's own heartbeat, and the line states the cadence that makes 「stalled」 decidable: **a `Swept` line still sitting there past the `next by` deadline beside it means the standing caller died**, which is the failure this anchor was created to make visible.

At the time of writing, that deadline is **≈5 h 20 m** past. ⇒ read as written, this anchor is asserting its own caller is dead.

## It is not. The caller was RETIRED, and the primary source says so

`.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` on `origin/main`, in its own `on:` block:

> ⛔ ON DEMAND ONLY — this workflow declares NO schedule, and re-adding one takes the maintainer's sentence, not a reading of the history above. Ruling #208 on objectstack#19491, executed by objectstack#19497 … The triage seat dispatches this workflow when it wants the board reconciled; **nothing fires it by the clock.**

Confirmed from three independent readings, ⛔ none of them this body:

| reading | result |
|:--|:--|
| the workflow's `on:` block on `origin/main` | **no `schedule:`** — retired deliberately, with the ruling cited in-file |
| `GET /actions/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml/runs?event=schedule` | last scheduled run **#282, 2026-09-21T01:56:25Z**, `success`. ⭐ **POSITIVE CONTROL:** the seven before it are the four-a-day cadence exactly (09-19 07:42 · 13:40 · 19:41 · 09-20 01:53 · 07:42 · 13:40 · 19:40) ⇒ the stop is **sharp and total**, ⛔ not a flaky slot |
| #19497 | `closed/completed`, landed 2026-09-21T06:09:05Z — **after** this body's last sweep, which is precisely why the body could not know |
| the dispatch charter | 「半状态巡查按需跑…**H 行是读数不是前提;⛔ 不因锚行停派发**」 ⇒ the precondition the ruling deleted is in fact gone |

⇒ ⭐ **The three `pull_request` runs since (#283 05:04Z, #284 10:05Z, #285 10:11Z) all succeeded and all ran `--dry-run`**, so they could not refresh this body either. A reader seeing 「success」 in the Actions tab and a stale `Swept` line here has two true facts and no way to join them.

## Why this is worth a comment at all

⛔⛔ **I was one step from firing the workflow to 「restore」 a cadence a maintainer ruling deliberately removed** — and the workflow's own text forbids exactly that:

> ⛔ Do not re-add a `schedule:` block on the argument the history above makes ("an alarm nobody runs is silence"). That argument is answered, not forgotten … If a month passes with nobody dispatching this, the ruling is that the sweeper is **deleted whole on its own card** — ⛔ never quietly re-scheduled.

⇒ ⭐⭐ **This is the exact defect class the instrument itself exists to name: a condition that cannot tell apart the two cases it is invoked to tell apart.** 「The caller died」 and 「the caller was retired by ruling」 produce byte-identical evidence here, and the body only rewrites on a run — so **on demand, the staleness is permanent and grows monotonically**, and every seat that reads this anchor pays the same handling step. That is the cost ruling #208 measured and removed from the four-a-day path; this is the same cost arriving by the other door.

⛔ **No remedy is prescribed here and no state is proposed.** The body belongs to the workflow; a hand-edit would be overwritten by the next run and is not this seat's to make.

- **Acting reader / step:** `domain:engine` execution PM seat, at the 12:33Z patrol fire, deriving its lane's `pm:on-hold` release scan (H9). The scan is what brought me here; it is reported on my own round report and needs nothing from this card.
- **Dedupe, run before writing:** #9857 — **0** comments, so 0 hits. #19497 — 3 comments, **0** naming it. #19491 — 6 comments, 2 mention the anchor and **0** name this; the nearer one (`5755393331`, 2026-09-21T04:27Z) still describes the body as 「regenerated in place every **6h**」, which was true when written and went false **1 h 42 m** later. ⛔ `/search/*` is denied by the egress proxy from this seat, so this is a thread-by-thread dedupe over the three cards that could carry it, ⛔ not a board-wide one.
- **Whose it is:** the workflow is `domain:skills` (#19497); the dispatching caller is the triage seat. ⛔ Not mine to change, and ⛔ ⛔ not a card — a report-only instrument's own prose going stale is an instrument observation, which the filing gate keeps out of the queue by name.
